# All electoral countries at recorded trigger checks

These are country-month exposure counts in one development run, not independent experiments. `A/U/I` counts absent Army/unsettled/interim; these and L/D/P overlap. L means loyalty >=.35; D means discontent <.25; P means pressure below threshold1. Minimum loyalty, maximum pressure and maximum penalty use all that country's trigger checks; dates/line witnesses and exact joint combinations are in countries.json. `Paid` counts all recorded government-AI increases for that country, including regime months.
